correctness.rationale: Cohorts of equal initial color never split; replacing each size by min(size,2) faithfully preserves the threshold at every time. Each shore has 26 nonempty capped profiles and the exhaustive finite quotient has 676 pairs, with exact period/preperiod histogram (145,15,6,171,36,225,6,72) ordered (0,1),(0,3),(0,4),(1,1),(1,4),(2,1),(2,4),(3,1). The actual code constructs a full four-variable integer monomial census and verifies exact polynomial identities for B3 and B4; substitution of e^z-1-z for capped-2 cohorts and z for singletons is an all-a,b exponential generating-function proof, not interpolation from samples. Independently reconstructed 676 signatures and four-variable coefficient identities, and checked all-size moment/existence boundaries. All 676 signatures are covered; initial cohorts cannot split. The theorem does not classify individual fixed-point attraction basins.
